## Research Interests

My research interests include:

- High-energy astrophysics
- Black holes (compact objects) and accretion physics
- Potential: AI-assisted scientific research

## Current Research

I am currently studying relativistic jet propagation in
AGN-disk environments, using numerical simulations
to investigate jet dynamics and environmental effects.
